title: Transcriptomics of Mononuclear Cells and Inflammatory Status of Obese Patients Treated With Omega-3 Fatty Acids

sections.abstract: The main objective is to determine the effect that supplementation with 4.8 g/day of w-3 FA \[3.2g eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and 1.6 g docosahexaenoic acid (DHA)\] have on the inflammatory state of obese patients (BMI ≥ 35.0 kg/m2), at the metabolic, cellular and molecular levels.
